role: CloudKit sync support: timeout error, the snapshot-backfill notification name, the MainActor SyncSerializer that chains CloudKitSyncManager operations, the CloudKitSettingsSync singleton that backs UserSettings up to/restores it from an encrypted CloudKit record, the CloudSettingsRecord field layout, localized sync status strings, and CloudSessionPayload which strips (upload) and restores (pull) every HealthKit-derived reading in an HRVSession.
types: SyncTimeoutError: enum — .timedOut/.stalled thrown by CloudKitSyncManager+Push runWithTimeout
SyncSerializer: class (@MainActor) — serializes async closures by chaining Tasks
CloudKitSettingsSync: class (@Observable @MainActor singleton) — debounced/immediate settings push, restore, one-time health scrub of stored record
CloudSettingsRecord: enum — field names and encode/decode of settings record payload
CloudSessionPayload: enum — HealthKit-reading stripping/restoring for session payloads
HRVAnalysisResult / ANSMetrics / Split / Lap: extension — copy-with-one-field helpers
state: mem:CloudKitSettingsSync.debounceTask / changeObserver / pushSerializer (SyncSerializer chaining pushes) / zoneEnsured / schemaUnavailable (per-launch sticky)
ck:UserSettings fields settingsPayload, modifiedAt, legacy settingsJSON, legacy deviceName (CloudSettingsRecord constants)
mem:CloudSessionPayload.healthKitDeviceIds {healthkit-import, healthkit-rebuild}, appleWatchDeviceId "apple-watch", heartRateContextKeys {hr, peak_hr}, healthKitFactorLabels {Sleep, Vitals}
toplevel: CloudKitSettingsSync.shared is created lazily on first access (static let); its private init registers the settings-change observer. CloudKitSettingsSync stored-property initializers build CKContainer(identifier: AppConfig.iCloudContainerIdentifier) and the UserSettings zone ID. SyncSerializer.previous starts as an empty completed Task. SyncSerializer carries @ObservationIgnored although the class is not @Observable (no effect).

units.does: Chains `body` after the previously queued Task: creates a MainActor Task that awaits the prior task then runs body, stores it as the new tail, and awaits it, so CloudKitSyncManager operations run one at a time in call order.
calls: closure:body supplied by CloudKitSyncManager: uploadSession (CloudKitSyncManager.swift:392), scrubHealthReadingsWhileSyncOff (:466), markSessionsForReupload (:627), uploadDeletion (:638), performFullSync (:674), and CloudKitSyncManager+Deletion.swift:49

flags.text: No timeout or cancellation: a body that never returns blocks every later run() caller forever, because each new Task awaits the previous one unconditionally.
